name: Conductive: Brine and Shock grant stacks, Torrential Wrath triggers Conduction and keeps them (#9741, #4245, #12565)
contract: Conductive's passive (92098) reads '$?s560020[Brine][Shock] now grants Conductive for $567559d, stacking $567559u times.' Its only effect is a PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL of Conduction (567560) with ProcFlags 0, so nothing ever applied the stacking buff 567559 (30 sec, 10 stacks). A Stormbringer hit-result hook now applies 567559 to the caster when a non-triggered Brine (family flag 1 & 128) or Shock (family flag 0 & 2048) hits while the passive is known. Without the passive, Brine grants nothing. Torrential Wrath (family flags 1 & 1, 2 & 32) then triggers Conduction (567560) while Conductive is up, boosted 30% per stack by 567573. The passive's current text, 'Torrential Wrath triggers Conduction while an enemy has Conductive active' (changed on 2026-08-01 from 'consumes all stacks of Conductive', per the AscensionDB history of 92098), and Torrential Wrath's own 'Depletes 40 Static' do not consume Conductive, so both auras stay and expire after their own 30 sec (#12565); a second Torrential Wrath triggers Conduction again. A miss deals no damage and grants no stack, so spell hit rating forces every cast to land.
